facts.text: Near avatar x=55,y=1241: dirt paths fork north and west, signs to the north, stone walls at screen corners.
Around x=55,y=1205 a north-south dirt path runs between stone buildings on the west and east sides.
Near x=55,y=1163: a well-like stone ring to the northeast, a fallen horse-like animal east; dirt path bends northwest.
Near x=40,y=1158: east-west dirt path; north stone building with brown door, two white pillars, brown object to the northeast.
At avatar x=49,y=1153: brown door is up-left; fallen horse and round stone ring lie to the east/southeast.
At x=48,y=1148: narrow grassy passage leads north between west stone building and east grey walls.
At x=55,y=1241 one sign stands up-left (by the north path) and another up-right near the east stone wall.

Around x=61,y=1254: grassy area bounded by a stone wall to the south and east; brown figures lie to the northwest.
At x=31,y=1232: gap between a north and a southwest stone building; door-like openings on north wall (east) and SW building's east side.
At x=31,y=1232 a north-building door lies a short way east (about x=39); another door is a bit west.
At x=55,y=1241 a brown figure stands immediately right of the avatar on the dirt path.

A group (likely the Fellowship) is 'community minded citizens'; Lord British endorsed it, so ask him about it.

At x=55,y=1157: a building west-northwest has a wooden door and a signpost beside it.

At x=45,y=1157 a large brown creature or body lies to the east beside the dirt path, which bends south there.

At x=71,y=1234: signpost just north, a wooden door on a stone building's south face up-right; barrels and a well east.

At x=40,y=1233: two people on the dirt path to the southeast; doors up-right and down-left, barrel to the west.

At x=50,y=1240 a conversation opened: portraits of a man in a yellow hood and a blond long-haired man.

Lead: ask Lord British about the community group he has endorsed.
Petre's conversation menu offers the topic 'Fellowship' (also 'Again', 'Bye!').
After Petre's Fellowship answer only 'Again' and 'Bye!' remain; choose 'Bye!' to leave.

At x=82,y=1193: wall to east with white creature beyond; barrel and brown door at lower building south; door up-left.
